coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left of the page, y grows downward; x0,y0 = top-left and x1,y1 = bottom-right of the OUTER edge of the printed box
how_measured: The form on every page is ONE raster JPEG (742 x 960 px, about 107 ppi) placed on the page; it is not vector drawing. Boxes were found in the JPEG pixels (closed light-grey rectangles) and converted to points with the image placement matrix read from the page content stream. 1 px = 0.675 pt, so each edge is good to about 1 pt.

1.why: 61 closed boxes found by image analysis and each one checked by eye on a 2x overlay. One (Custodian Stamp Here) is a judgement call, marked optional.

2.why: 71 boxes found automatically, 1 small PRIMARY box (beneficiary 2) added from its pixels by hand, 4 short SECONDARY ___% rules added from pixel rows; all checked by eye.

4.why: 7 rows x 2 initials boxes; count and columns checked by eye.

5.why: 19 boxes, each checked by eye. Whether the broker-dealer blanks get fields is a product decision; they are printed places to complete, so they are listed.

7.why: 16 rows x 2 initials boxes; count matches the 16 statements read by eye.

8.why: 8 rows x 2 initials boxes; count matches the 8 statements.
